entries.title: Miami Art Week begins (runs through Dec 6, anchored by Art Basel Miami Beach)
Art Basel Miami Beach VIP preview days begin (Dec 2-3). Global Lead Partner is UBS
Art Basel Miami Beach public days (Dec 4-6), Miami Beach Convention Center
Federal Reserve G.19 Consumer Credit release (3:00pm ET), tracks revolving credit and card balances

Goldman Sachs US Financial Services Conference, New York (Dec 8-9 per company announcements). Goldman CFO speaks Dec 8 at about 10am ET; Fifth Third and Blackstone present Dec 9. Check for card issuer and network sessions
FOMC rate decision, projections and dot plot (meeting Dec 8-9). Statement 2:00pm ET, press conference 2:30pm ET
FOMC minutes for the Dec 8-9 meeting (2:00pm ET)
JPMorgan Chase Q4 2026 earnings (call 8:30am ET). Just outside the 6-week window, listed as the first big-bank report
Wells Fargo Q4 2026 earnings (release about 7:00am ET, call 10:00am ET). Just outside the 6-week window
Citi Q4 2026 earnings (release about 8am ET, call 11:00am ET). Just outside the 6-week window
Bank of America Q4 2026 earnings (release about 6:45am ET, call 8:30am ET). Just outside the 6-week window
American Express Q4 2026 earnings (aggregator-projected date; other aggregators show Jan 29, so treat as unconfirmed). Outside the 6-week window
Capital One Q4 2026 earnings (tentative per aggregators, other sources show Jan 21; not company-confirmed). Outside the 6-week window
Capri Holdings fiscal Q3 2027 earnings (estimated by aggregator, not company-confirmed). Outside the 6-week window
Tapestry fiscal Q2 2027 earnings (company-stated date). Outside the 6-week window
Affirm fiscal Q2 2027 earnings (estimated; aggregators also show Feb 11, so treat as unconfirmed). Outside the 6-week window
Hermes 2026 annual results (8:00am CET, per company calendar). Outside the 6-week window
